title: Fancy Pink pear diamond pendant, rose gold
subtitle: Fancy pink is a geological accident — nitrogen arranged under the right pressure, over the right time, in the right conditions. The pear shape was chosen deliberately: its axis gives the color a direction, so the warmth concentrates at the tip and opens toward the shoulder as the stone moves. The rose gold setting reads the same color temperature as the diamond. The piece exists to hold the color.
